# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

- All Omah Aksara themes and invitations, including Army and Venni–Rama, are in scope for authorized improvement. No theme is permanently locked.
- Inspect current open PRs and changed files before editing; use a dedicated branch and PR.
- Preserve engine/data/theme contracts, client records, RSVP/guestbook, payment details, slugs, URLs, Apps Script, and production endpoints unless the task explicitly authorizes a carefully tested migration.
- Use demo fixtures, mocks, and isolated TEST services. Never submit dummy data to production.
- Back up and verify before bulk or destructive changes; provide rollback for migrations.
- Keep theme identities distinct, mobile-first, accessible, performant, and respectful of reduced-motion.
- Do not work directly on `main`, merge, force-push, delete, or deploy without owner approval.
- Report actual test evidence; distinguish passed, failed, skipped, and not run.
- Do not add paid APIs, secrets, or dependencies without approval.

GitHub issues and PRs are the shared coordination record. Do not assume another AI agent has been invoked or has seen this conversation.
